faqs.q: Do I need to book in advance?
faqs.a: Walk-ins are welcome, but we recommend booking online or via WhatsApp to guarantee your preferred time. Bookings are confirmed within 2 hours.
No upfront payment is needed. Simply pay at the spa before your treatment — we accept cash (THB), PromptPay, and major payment methods.

faqs.q: Where is Crystal Aura Massage & Spa located?
faqs.a: We are at 22 Nimmana Haeminda Rd Lane 13, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai 50200, in the heart of the Nimman area.
We are open every day from 09:00 to 23:30, including weekends and holidays.

items.q: How much does a Thai massage cost in Chiang Mai?
items.a: At Crystal Aura Massage & Spa in Nimman, a traditional Thai massage starts from ฿400 for 60 minutes. Aromatherapy massages start from ฿790, and full spa packages range from ฿1,250 to ฿3,000.

items.q: What is the difference between Thai massage and aromatherapy massage?
items.a: Traditional Thai massage uses acupressure and deep stretching with no oil, performed in loose clothing. Aromatherapy massage uses custom-blended essential oils with gentle flowing strokes — ideal for relaxation and stress relief.

items.q: Is it customary to tip at a spa in Thailand?
items.a: Tipping is appreciated but never required. If you enjoyed your treatment, 50–100 THB is a kind gesture for your therapist.

items.q: Should I shower before or after a Thai massage?
items.a: We recommend a warm shower before your session to relax the muscles. After an oil massage, it is best to wait a few hours before showering so your skin absorbs the essential oils.

items.q: How often should you get a Thai massage?
items.a: For general wellness, once every 1–2 weeks is ideal. For specific muscle tension or recovery, your therapist may recommend more frequent sessions.
